description: The EIB – the European Union’s bank and a global leader in climate finance –in the framework of its GRAD programme, is seeking to recruit for its Operations Directorate (OPS), at its headquarters in Luxembourg, Junior Professionals*.Internal benchmark: GraduateThis Opportunity Is For You IfYou have a degree in Business Administration, Banking, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering or another related subject. You want to start your career in a friendly, diverse, international environment.You’re curious to learn how a major European financial institution works from the inside.If this sounds like you, keep reading!Panel interviews are anticipated for January-February 2026. PurposeWe are recruiting Junior Professionals to take on operational roles within OPS.If you are selected, you will receive more information about the team that best match your profile.As a Junior Professional, You WillReceive a 3-year contract, with the possibility to extend up to 4 years.Move to another OPS team after 12–18 months, depending on business needs.Gain hands-on experience from day one, working on real tasks and projects.Take part in a dedicated OPS induction, in addition to the Bank’s general orientation.Learn directly from experienced colleagues who will act as your mentors.Access a wide range of free in-house training to support your development and growth.Operating NetworkYou will be joining an operational team within OPS, the EIB’s largest directorate, with around 760 colleagues across six departments.These Departments Are OperationalCorporatePublic SectorFinancial InstitutionsEquity, Growth Capital & Project FinanceAcross These Teams, OPS Is Responsible ForSupporting and delivering projects across the EU.Turning the Bank’s annual plan into concrete actions.Managing funds that help finance EIB activities.Advising public authorities and project promoters using EU funds.This environment will give you the chance to work on projects that have real impact, while building strong experience at the start of your career.OPS is the EIB’s client-facing directorate, responsible for the origination and execution of projects inside of the European Union and for delivering the bank’s business plan (“Operational Plan”) in line with priorities defined by its shareholders, the EU’s 27 Member States. Any language clause in your contract must be fulfilled in order for you to be eligible for a promotion (either via the annual appraisal cycle or via an internal selection process).
